{{Quote|It's a mutiny, Lord Vader! They've executed all of the officers and locked down the communications array.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Voca]] to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="DV&tLC-4" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a '''mutiny''' took place aboard [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Atoan system]], between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] loyal forces of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shale (human)|Shale's]] traitorous [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]].
